Record all the transaction like inward/outward, and damage/loss details digitally or manually
Manage all necessary quality records of the project
Conduct internal and external audit periodically and maintain record

modules.module_title: Manage manpower and implement improvement practices

pcs.pc_description: Support Shift In Charge/Process head in finalizing the shift rosters of the manpower based on the production plan
Maintain the information on leaves/in-out time and shift/line overtime of the team and share the information with the concerned authorities as per the organisational procedures
Send inventory requirements to stores and purchase department and follow up with them to ensure the timely receipt of materials (Spares, Consumables, etc.)
Work collaboratively with maintenance, engineering, and production teams to minimize downtime and ensure seamless operations
Ensure optimal resource utilization (man, machine and material) and streamlining of activities within the shift
Identify opportunities for process improvement and implement innovative solutions to enhance plant performance
Conduct regular audits and inspections to ensure compliance with safety and environmental regulations
Track and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure process performance and identify optimization opportunities
Conduct daily floor meeting/morning meetings/staff meetings to communicate the information such as production targets, new guidelines, new processes etc. to team
Organize training sessions for the operators and technicians to improve their skills and knowledge on new techniques and methods
Obtain instructions from the manager regarding production targets and planning
Prepare plan and schedule to meet the production target and give instructions to the operators and technicians about the processes required to be performed for achieving the same
Ensure that all the tools, equipment and raw materials required for the job are in stock, functioning properly and as per the required quality standards
Support the operators and technicians in setting of the operating parameters as per the work instructions
Provide technical expertise and support to operational teams, assisting in resolving complex operational issues and driving continuous improvement initiatives
Ensure smooth operation of hydrogen production process
Monitor and optimize hydrogen production processes using various tools and technologies to maximize efficiency and cost-effectiveness
Control and monitor the electrolyzer functioning, water purification system, gas purification systems, gas separation systems etc. to maintain the required production quality
Analyze data collected from monitoring systems to identify trends, diagnose problems, and optimize system efficiency
Check production output according to specifications
Adhere to safety protocols and guidelines, industry standards, regulations, and environmental requirements while working on renewable energy systems and green hydrogen facilities
Implement robust standard operating procedures (SOPs) for process control and troubleshooting
Prepare MIS reports to analyse the actual performance with the production target and report the same to manager
Maintain accurate documentation and records of process parameters, incidents, and production activities
Participate in the planning and execution of planned major maintenance activities, such as plant shutdowns
Read the maintenance schedule and plan the time and schedule for maintenance of equipment based on the manufacturer’s recommendations
Prepare estimates and bill of quantity for carrying out maintenance activity
Study the critical areas to find out possibilities of impending breakdowns, leakages, failures etc.
Plan and supervise maintenance activities for renewable energy systems and green hydrogen infrastructure
Carry out, organize and supervise routine maintenance activities & rectification of defects in a timely manner
Guide the maintenance team and supervise troubleshooting and repairing activities of faulty or unhealthy equipment
Ensure that all maintenance activities are adequately addressed
Conduct trials of the equipment/system to ensure that maintenance is done properly and equipment /system is functioning properly without any abnormalities
Report about maintenance activity done on the equipment and suggest modifications in the maintenance schedule, if required to the superiors
Analyse machine breakdown trends and current maintenance process to identify areas of improvement and corrective actions for improving the same

modules.module_title: Follow workplace health and safety practices

pcs.pc_description: use protective clothing/equipment for specific tasks and work conditions (Protective clothing: leather or asbestos gloves, flame proof aprons, flame proof overalls buttoned to neck, cuff less (without folds) trousers, reinforced footwear, helmets/hard hats, cap and shoulder covers, ear defenders/plugs, safety boots, knee pads, particle masks, glasses/goggles/visors) (Equipment: hand and face shields, machine guards, residual current devices, shields, dust sheets, respirator)

identify job-site hazards and possible causes of risks/accident at the workplace (Hazards: electrical hazards, sharp edged and heavy tools, heated metals, oxyfuel and gas cylinders, welding radiation, hazardous surfaces, hazardous substances, physical hazards. Possible causes of risk and accident: physical actions, not following instructions, inattention, sickness and incapacity, health, not taking safety precautions)
use standard safe working practices when working at heights, confined areas, trenches and with electrical equipment
follow warning signs and symbols while working with electrical systems (Warning signs: Danger plate, high voltage area, out of service, etc.)
ensure positive isolation of electrical equipment and system as per the given standards
identify any abnormalities in electrical equipment or system viz temperature, pressure, flow of current etc.

use various methods of accident prevention in the work environment (Methods of accident prevention: use of equipment and working practices, safety notices, advice, instruction from colleagues and supervisors)
use proper scaffolds, elevated platforms and ladders for working at height
inspect various tools and plants (T & P) routinely for any signs of oil, water leakages
store flammable materials and machine lubricating oil safely and correctly
check that the emission and pollution control devices are working properly in line with environmental policy standards
inform the relevant authorities about any abnormal situation/behavior of any equipment/system without delay
use various appropriate fire extinguishers for different types of fires correctly (Types of fires: Class A, B, C, D and E)
use appropriate rescue techniques during fire hazard
use good housekeeping practices at all times to avoid accidental fire

modules.module_title: Follow emergencies, rescue and first-aid procedures

pcs.pc_description: administer appropriate first aid to the victims for the relevant injuries (Injuries: Bleeding, burns, choking, electric shock, poisoning etc.)
act promptly and appropriately to an accident situation and administer basic first aid including CPR to the victims of cardiac arrest due to electric shock or medical emergency in real
write an incident report and send the same to the authorized person
